caption:
Hackers breach US Air Force's Cloud One cloud computing platform

The intrusion was found within the past month during a system upgrade, three people familiar with the matter said. Cloud One powers the Air Force's air defense radar and other data feeds, according to Reuters sources. The breach could put a vast swathe of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data at risk. The discovery has led to disruption across the platform, two of the people said.

Reported by South China Morning Post; Bloomberg; Reuters.
